# Tooltip

Adds a short explanation to a focusable control.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="tooltip" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | Required | Tooltip text |
| `delay` | number | 250 | Hover delay (ms) |

### Slots

- default: a single focusable trigger element

## Keyboard and usage notes

Shows when the trigger is hovered or focused; Escape dismisses it. On touch screens, show essential information directly instead of only in a tooltip.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmTooltip } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```
